name: Seachem Flourish (Comprehensive)
description: Comprehensive trace-element + micronutrient supplement (iron, manganese, and other micros; not a primary macro source). Seachem publishes a guaranteed analysis but not a per-dose ppm, so values are NOT disclosed — qualitative `affects` only.
notes: Label dose ~5 ml per 250 L twice weekly. A micro/trace product despite the name 'Comprehensive' — supply macros separately.
